title: Integer relief branch heuristic and direct three-wavelength height optimization
status: preliminary nonconvex scalar optimization; heuristic branch map and one bounded Adam run, not a global optimum

reference.ideal_operator: f(lambda)=f0*lambda0/lambda; same physical Fourier coordinate grid

integer_branch_heuristics.selection_rule: per pupil pixel, choose m in [0, cap] minimizing the sum of squared phasor differences from the 532 nm reference screen at 450 and 633 nm; 532 nm remains exact
integer_branch_heuristics.note: local phase matching is only a heuristic; it does not directly minimize image error and does not constrain neighboring height steps

joint_continuous_height_design.method: analytic-gradient Adam optimization of continuous relief height, equal-weight three-wavelength normalized intensity L2 objective

joint_height_with_roi_power_penalty.method: analytic-gradient Adam continuing from the shape-only solution; adds a quadratic penalty when target-ROI power is below the selected floor
joint_height_with_roi_power_penalty.constraint_note: soft penalty, not a hard guarantee that every wavelength reaches the floor
